label: FAKE: hand-written demo data, not real model output
purpose: Demo test cases, one per criterion.

test_cases.title: Validated result is sent as FHIR
preconditions: Patient has consent recorded in the HIS
steps: Inspect the message sent to the NHX test endpoint
test_cases.expected_result: A FHIR resource matching the NHX specification is received.

test_cases.title: Unvalidated result is not sent
steps: Save a lab result without validating it
test_cases.expected_result: No message is sent to NHX.

test_cases.title: No consent, no message
preconditions: The HIS has no consent for the patient
test_cases.expected_result: Nothing is sent, and the log states missing consent as the reason.

test_cases.title: Correction updates the same result
steps: Inspect the message sent to NHX
test_cases.expected_result: The message updates the existing result rather than creating a new one.

test_cases.title: Messages carry a token
preconditions: A valid NHX token is configured
test_cases.expected_result: The message carries a valid NHX token.

test_cases.title: Invalid token blocks sending
test_cases.expected_result: The message is not transmitted and an error is logged.

test_cases.title: Retry when NHX is down
preconditions: The NHX test endpoint is unavailable
test_cases.expected_result: The message is retried and delivered once NHX responds.

test_cases.title: Rejected message can be corrected and resent
preconditions: The NHX test endpoint rejects a message
test_cases.expected_result: The rejection is listed with its reason, and the corrected message is resent.
